verdict.rationale: Ramp documents automatic receipt capture tied to card swipes, with memos and categories filled in and edits submittable via SMS, Slack or Teams. The CLI also documents receipt upload and attach, which covers filing a receipt against a transaction. However, the specific employee flows in the story are not documented: snapping a photo, forwarding an email, and OCR of expense receipts. The only OCR claim is for bill-pay invoices, so it does not transfer here. Missing for 10: documented photo-snap capture, email-forward receipt ingestion, explicit receipt OCR, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automatic matching to the right transaction.

support.subject: As an employee, I can snap a photo or forward an email and the platform OCRs the receipt and files it against the right transaction

citations.quote: As soon as you swipe your card, Ramp captures the receipt and fills in memos and categories. Make edits and submit via SMS, Slack, or Microsoft Teams.
the receipt is captured automatically, coded to the correct GL account, and auto-approved because it's within policy
